INSERT INTO amz_performance_owner_rule ( stat_month, group_code, rule_type, match_key, principal_name, source_file_name, source_sheet, source_row, imported_by, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{row.statMonth}, #{row.groupCode}, #{row.ruleType}, #{row.matchKey}, #{row.principalName}, #{row.sourceFileName}, #{row.sourceSheet}, #{row.sourceRow}, #{row.importedBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE principal_name = VALUES(principal_name), source_file_name = VALUES(source_file_name), source_sheet = VALUES(source_sheet), source_row = VALUES(source_row), imported_by = VALUES(imported_by), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT group_code AS groupCode, rule_type AS ruleType, COUNT(*) AS ruleCount, MAX(update_time) AS updateTime FROM amz_performance_owner_rule WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth} GROUP BY group_code, rule_type ORDER BY FIELD(group_code, 'EU', 'US1', 'US2'), rule_type
